entries.subject: SDSS DR9 color HiPS
entries.finding: A 2100 x 2100 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 17.1 arcmin wide on the HyperLEDA position. The red channel reaches 255 at the nucleus (brightest pixel 255, 226, 147 of 255). In 20 arcsec elliptical annuli the cleaned light comes within one count of the corner sky at 600 arcsec, beyond the 511.682 arcsec the spheroid reaches.

entries.subject: A flat picture facing the Sun
entries.finding: M59 was first drawn as one flat Sloan picture facing the Sun, the route of the Messier galaxies with no published shape. Seen from the side that picture is a line. Kormendy et al. publish M59's profile and shape, so the volume replaces it.

entries.subject: Catalogues for the masks
entries.finding: HyperLEDA PGC sizes 6 neighbours; the 2MASS Extended Source Catalog sizes 2 that HyperLEDA lists without a D25. NOX leaves the haloes of bright stars, so 16 Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 15 are masked too. At M87's three D25 radii a close neighbour's mask covers M59's own centre, so each mask stops at nine tenths of its distance from the centre.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Kormendy et al. (2009), Table 1, row NGC 4621: major-axis Sérsic fit n = 5.36 (+0.3, -0.28), r_e = 74.63 (+4.62, -3.96) arcsec. Table 3 rows at 67.22 and 75.336 arcsec, interpolated to the half-light radius: ellipticity 0.373, position angle 164.37 degrees. Used as published; no fit was made here.

entries.subject: Globular cluster dots
entries.finding: Jordán et al. (2009), Table 4, VCC 1903: the 308 sources with a probability of being a globular cluster of at least 0.5, the authors' own cut, drawn as dots through the same spheroid. They fill only the Hubble field on the centre.
